title: Keep service failures fixed and free of private room information
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/PILOT100_BACKLOG.md, docs/design/SWARM-BRIEF-v0.md, docs/design/RULES-SPEC-v1.md and the listed sourceRefs before editing. The imported Rules Spec v1 is the canonical engine contract; the earlier prototype/T01-T10 interfaces are baseline compatibility, not current gameplay rules. Do not restore approval votes, Repair/Sabotage buttons, Witness or five-node tracks. Preserve original IP and engine independence from Firebase/UI/Node. Edit only ownership; publish APIs only through explicitly owned package entrypoints, preserving baseline exports. Use original synthetic fixtures, scoped tests/lint/typecheck and npm run check. Do not commit, push, open PRs, spawn agents, provision/deploy services, access credentials or alter swarm budget. Define the fixed ServiceFailureV1 allowlist for invalid_request,unauthenticated,not_member,not_found,room_full,room_closed,invalid_passcode,revision_conflict,request_conflict,phase_conflict,deadline_not_reached,action_not_allowed,rate_limited,not_supported,internal. Public failures contain only ok:false,a fixed code and an independently validated optional requestId; map unknown errors to internal. Error output never includes passcode/hash,auth claims,seed,roles,Route/Gate diagnostics/choices,vote identity during S2,raw input,stack or cause. Do not expose whether a hidden room exists to an unauthorized caller; A051 determines any uniform join denial. No provider status code mapping belongs in this pure module.
acceptance: Only fixed declared codes/allowed metadata are serializable; arbitrary error messages and nested provider data are excluded.
Malformed request IDs and hostile getters/toString cannot leak input or execute through error conversion.
Synthetic failures containing passcodes,seed,Null/Static identity,private choices and sealed votes never appear in output.
Tests cover every fixed code and unknown/native/provider-style errors without network or SDK dependencies.
